_meta.purpose: Trigger payload for workflow-engine to begin offboarding cascade for a leaving employee.

tenant_id.description: The work tenant whose membership will be revoked. The cascade is scoped to this tenant only.

drive_transfer_target.description: Principal in the SAME tenant to receive ownership of the leaver's drive files. Per drive µservice's transfer-target whitelist, MUST be intra-tenant.

messenger_team_thread_preservation.description: If true, team-owned threads remain readable to other team members after leaver's archive.

dsar_email.description: Optional. If provided, after cascade completes, send a DSAR-portability link to this email per ADR-0276.
